description: This file contains the Catalan localization strings for the Select2 plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines localized messages for various user interface elements and error messages within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading data fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that the user's input exceeds the maximum allowed length, specifying how many characters to remove.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that the user's input is too short, specifying how many more characters are needed.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when the maximum number of selectable items has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search operation is ongoing.
